decisions.decision: Coverage diagnostics report the gate as inactive and every protected consumer as unverified until dual-branch activation evidence exists in the database; 04-CHARACTERIZATION.md is not treated as live evidence.
decisions.rationale: D-12 requires diagnostics to show inactive or blocked until dual-branch release evidence succeeds.

decisions.decision: The resolved-provenance endpoint accepts only three validated integers and returns exactly one existing resolver result; a package or count pair is an eligibility outcome (reusable_count_scope), never a resolved factor.
decisions.rationale: Keeps the browser from selecting units, factors, or destinations and prevents a count pair from borrowing a reusable rule.

decisions.decision: 04-09 executes before 04-06. 04-06-PLAN.md declares depends_on [04-09] and reads 04-09-SUMMARY.md; the roadmap places 04-09 in Wave 6 and 04-06 in Wave 7. The previous handoff ordering was stale.
decisions.rationale: The plan dependency graph and roadmap agree against the stale handoff.

decisions.decision: No reusable projection has been selected; reusable profiles and rules remain inactive until immutable dual-branch evidence passes.
decisions.rationale: Characterization establishes native behavior but does not prove a safe reusable projection.

decisions.rationale: It adds read-only resolved-conversion provenance while retaining the native table and no-write boundary.
